method.evaluations: one (seed, sampled target); calibration targets excluded except in shares.sgcn_u1_over_u2
method.operators: U1 = unlink (inference-only, input features recomputed); U2 = exact_retrain
method.ci95: Every headline field has a 95% interval ci95, and ci95_source says how it was made (ruling R30). By default ci95 is the hull of two intervals, keeping the lower of the two lower bounds and the higher of the two upper bounds. The first, ci95_bootstrap, is the percentile interval of the two-way crossed bootstrap of ruling R29: each of 10,000 replicates resamples the seeds with replacement and, independently, the target set once, and every resampled seed uses the same resampled targets. The second, ci95_seed_t, is a t-interval over the per-seed statistics with n_seeds - 1 degrees of freedom, centred on their mean, which is the point estimate; for a ratio of seed-averaged means (the U1/U2 shares) it is centred on that ratio and uses the linearized per-seed residuals. The hull is needed because with five seeds the percentile bootstrap understates the seed variance, so for fields that vary only across seeds the t-interval is in effect the headline. A 0/1-valued field whose point estimate is exactly 0 or 1 has a degenerate bootstrap and t-interval; its ci95 is instead the Clopper-Pearson interval over the distinct targets, because the same targets recur in every seed: for the escape rates and the bottom-quartile share a target counts once, and for logit.frac_over_0.003 a target counts as exceeding 0.003 if any of its evaluations does. ci95_nested is the nested bootstrap of ruling R21 (targets resampled within each drawn seed), kept as a sensitivity; a dataset whose seeds drew different targets uses it as its bootstrap (see ci_design). A replicate is undefined when a drawn seed that has cells gives a 0/0 statistic or when no drawn seed has a cell; undefined replicates are dropped and counted in ci_undefined_replicates, and an interval with more than 1% undefined replicates is refused. Finally each headline interval is clipped to the mathematical support of its field, which is declared where the field is computed and recorded in ci95_support (ruling R31): proportions, escape rates, percentiles (stored as fractions), mean proxies and the MCC-optimal threshold to [0, 1]; a mean count to [0, its largest possible value] (cohort_below_tau_mean to [0, cohort size]); a mean magnitude (rater_term_mean_abs) to [0, inf). Signed quantities (gains, logit shifts, test-MCC changes) and ratios with a signed numerator (amplifications, U1/U2 shares, partial-deletion shares) are not clipped; a ratio of non-negative quantities would be clipped at 0 from below. When clipping changes an interval, the unclipped one is kept in ci95_unclipped and ci95_source says so.
method.ci95_not_applicable: edgeless.n and edgeless.share are cohort censuses; max_dmcc.c2_u2 and placebo_u2 are maxima; logit['n_over_0.003'] is a count (its fraction has a CI)
method.null_fields: epinions-dated: tau_mcc.cohort_below_tau (its probe4 runs have no full-cohort retrain; sample_below_tau is given) and shares.sgcn_u1_over_u2 (no SGCN baseline runs)
method.edgeless: cohort target with no training edge left once C2 deletes all its distrust in-edges
method.cold_start: per seed, mean stored U1 proxy (and platform percentile) of the sampled edgeless targets; that this equals the encoder's score for an account with no edge would need model inference, which this module does not run (ruling R22)
method.percentile: platform percentile among active accounts (pct_before, pct_after); escape_bottomX: share of targets starting below X that end at X or above under U1, mean over seeds
method.amplification: per seed mean U2 gain / mean yardstick shift, averaged over seeds; yardsticks: Laplace (d+ + 1)/(d + 2); raw d+/d (0/0 = 1); base-rate prior (d+ + 2p)/(d + 2) with p the training trust share; logreg: P(+ | u -> v) on log1p signed degrees, fit on the training edges with the edge's own label left out of v's in-degrees and u's out-degrees (ruling R28; logreg_target_loo leaves it out of v's in-degrees only, ruling R20), scored over the 256 probe accounts with the self-pair dropped; its shift removes the deleted warnings from both endpoints' degrees
method.shares: ratio of five-seed means of U1 gain over U2 gain (LocalGDTE without calibration targets; SGCN over all 50 sampled targets per seed)
method.partial_deletion_u1: direct_greedy_curve unlink gains (attack.Scorer, trained input features kept) after k' of k warnings; share_of_full divides by the same targets' unlink_frozen_x gain, per seed as a ratio of means
method.logit: U1 shift of the target term b.z_T (d_tgt) and the rater term a.z_u (d_src), per target means over the probe panel, stored by probe4
method.max_dmcc: largest |test T1 MCC change| of a single U2 retrain, under C2 and under the placebo
method.tau_mcc: base.tau, the MCC-optimal edge threshold of the base model (threshold.optimal_threshold)
